what: Like redacted lines in a confidential document — the title rises from 100px below over .6s, then .6s later a dark ink bar is drawn line by line from the left over .6s, then the same-color cover over the bar is pulled away to the right end over .6s, revealing the light text on the bar (circ.inOut). The bar stays

options.[data-fx-part=bar]: Lines that become bars (children, one per line) — the cover is made by the part
options.[data-fx-part=head]: Title that comes to mind first (optional)
options.dur: Duration of bar drawing and cover reveal (seconds), default 0.6
options.gap: Delay in seconds before the bar starts after the title appears, default 0.6 — starts immediately if there is no title
options.delay: Wait before start (sec), default 0 — Brand about page 1
options.on: load starts immediately without waiting for scroll
